fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics published The 2024 Gambia Statistical Abstract, whose tables draw on school returns (MoBSE/PPARBD Statistical Yearbook 2023/2024), health facility reports (HMIS/DHIS2 2024), the Gambia Police Force, the Central Bank, the Tourism Board and civil aviation records, with trade tables for 2009-2024; earlier abstracts for 2016-2023 are listed on the GBoS site.
title: The 2024 Gambia Statistical Abstract
